origin: Original practice stimulus; reviewed axis/unit derivation

data.unit_rule: Vertical-axis unit divided by horizontal-axis unit; angle/count ratios may be dimensionless.
data.model_limit: Idealised practice data only. Do not infer that every real dataset is exact, that every line passes through the origin, or that the gradient is automatically a familiar constant.

gradient_meaning: The black-can slope is (70 − 78)/(100 − 0) = −0.08 °C/s. The shiny-can slope is (73 − 78)/(100 − 0) = −0.05 °C/s. The black can has the steeper negative gradient and cools faster under the matched conditions.
aim: compare initial cooling of identical black and shiny containers
arrangement: Two light metal cans of the same dimensions with black and shiny finishes, each holding 0.025 kg of water, matching lids with thermometer/stirrer holes, a balance, thermometers and stopwatch
